meta.note: Copied from the Vocabularium Sage design system for D05. Font stacks use system CJK fonts (owner decision, 12 October 2026), and system Cyrillic and Arabic fonts before them (D14, 0.9.0). Owner accepted Sage and Moss night on 12 October 2026.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the reading column and the deck list.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The deck sidebar on the left.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Module card bodies, the module window, menus and dialogs: anything that sits on the ground as an object.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill on list rows, nav items and module window entries.

tokens.name: surface-active
tokens.usage: The selected nav item and the selected view in the view switch.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: sidebar edge, toolbar rule, card outline, dividers inside a card. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on ground, surface, surface-hover and the status and family tints in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the main key, headings; also the fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary reading text: translations, the meaning preview in the page list.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, counts, dates, eyebrows, placeholders. 4.5:1 or more on ground, sidebar, surface and surface-active.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an ink fill (primary button).

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The wordmark's full stop. Decoration only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px solid at 2px offset; links on hover.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Marker under the main key where it appears inside Context.

tokens.name: highlight-green
tokens.usage: A green highlight the user chose in the editor's palette (D10, amended a third time).

tokens.name: highlight-blue
tokens.usage: A blue highlight the user chose in the editor's palette (D10, amended a third time).

tokens.name: highlight-pink
tokens.usage: A pink highlight the user chose in the editor's palette (D10, amended a third time).

tokens.name: highlight-orange
tokens.usage: A orange highlight the user chose in the editor's palette (D10, amended a third time).

tokens.name: status-busy
tokens.usage: Generating: the bouncing dots and their label.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Failed generation or save: inline text and its Retry action.

tokens.name: status-failed-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a row or card that needs attention because something failed.

tokens.name: fam-translation
tokens.usage: Languages family, called Translation until 0.8.0 (parent modules: German, Chinese; D08, K26): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-translation
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-translation.

tokens.name: fam-translation-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Translation fill.

tokens.name: fam-expertise
tokens.usage: Expertise family (Computer Science, Mathematics; D11, K30): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-expertise
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-expertise.

tokens.name: fam-expertise-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Expertise fill.

tokens.name: fam-meaning
tokens.usage: Meaning family (explanations, definitions): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-meaning
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-meaning.

tokens.name: fam-meaning-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Meaning fill: chips, a filter that is on.

tokens.name: fam-usage
tokens.usage: Usage family (examples, sentence usage): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-usage
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-usage.

tokens.name: fam-usage-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Usage fill.

tokens.name: fam-roots
tokens.usage: Roots family (etymology, character parts, history): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-roots
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-roots.

tokens.name: fam-roots-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Roots fill.

tokens.name: fam-connections
tokens.usage: Connections family (related words, comparisons): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-connections
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-connections.

tokens.name: fam-connections-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Connections fill.

tokens.name: fam-sound
tokens.usage: Sound family (pronunciation, audio): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-sound
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-sound.

tokens.name: fam-sound-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Sound fill.

tokens.name: fam-notes
tokens.usage: Notes family (Context, Text: the user's own input): tab fill and card top edge.

tokens.name: on-fam-notes
tokens.usage: Tab label on fam-notes.

tokens.name: fam-notes-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet Notes fill.

families.display: "Fraunces", Georgia, "Noto Naskh Arabic", "Geeza Pro", "Songti SC", "Noto Serif CJK SC", "Source Han Serif SC", "Noto Serif SC", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", serif
families.text: "Instrument Sans", "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Geeza Pro", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Microsoft YaHei", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: key-display
styles.usage: Main key that is a word: up to 24 characters (8 for CJK). CJK falls back to Noto Serif SC; use weight 900 there.

styles.name: key-phrase
styles.usage: Main key that is a phrase: up to 60 characters (20 for CJK).

styles.name: key-sentence
styles.sample: Wir wünschen euch viel Glück und Gesundheit.
styles.usage: Main key that is a sentence: up to 200 characters (70 for CJK). Wraps freely; text-wrap: pretty.

styles.name: key-passage
styles.sample: Es war einmal ein kleines Dorf am Rande eines großen Waldes…
styles.usage: Main key that is a passage (longer than a sentence). Shown as a reading block, clamped to 6 lines with Show all.

styles.name: deck-title
styles.usage: Screen titles: deck name, Your decks, deck settings.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section headings: Modules, Preview, Recently captured.

styles.name: list-key
styles.sample: Die Gesundheit meiner Familie ist mein größtes Glück.
styles.usage: Every main key in the page list and on cards, whatever its length: wraps to at most 2 lines.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Generated content that is read: meanings, explanations.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: „Wir wünschen euch viel 幸福 und Gesundheit.“

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Die Gesundheit meiner Familie ist mein größtes Glück.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav items, list meaning previews, toolbar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Module tab labels, buttons, the view switch.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase group headings in lists and the sidebar. Set text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between family tabs in a row; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between toolbar controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; nav item padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between controls in a header; phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (sides); gap between module cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections (header, cards, notes).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Main column top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Main column side padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status chips, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List rows, nav items, view switch segments.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs; module tabs use it on the top corners only.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Module cards, deck cards, the preview sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and a card lifted on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: A row or module while it is being dragged.

duration.note: Motion is quick and physical. Every duration collapses to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion, and looping animations stop.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Colour changes: row and nav hover fills.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Revealing hover actions (Edit · Retry · ⋯, Open →).

tokens.name: dur-spring
tokens.usage: Tab lift on card hover, list key nudge, window item slide.

tokens.name: dur-settle
tokens.usage: Larger objects: a card lifting, a gallery card rising.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One cycle of the Generating dots.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Anything that moves: a small overshoot, then settles.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things that appear: menus, toasts, a new module card.

tokens.name: ease-fade
tokens.usage: Opacity and colour changes.

tokens.name: width-sidebar
tokens.usage: Deck sidebar.

tokens.name: width-window
tokens.usage: Module window beside the page view (300 to 340).

tokens.name: width-reading
tokens.usage: Page view reading column.

tokens.name: width-list
tokens.usage: Deck page list column.
